shape.appetite: Program-scale catalogue delivered page by page behind a gate; prove gate and one fully live page before scaling.
shape.problem: Hand-written docs cover 3 of 20 chart types and none of the flows or surfaces, and nothing detects drift.
shape.recommended_shape: MDX docs inside the demo (research recommendation; Starlight fallback on triggers). Coverage targets derived from the chart registry, demos/coverage.ts, and a typed flows/surfaces list; pages declare covered targets. LiveExample mounts public ExplorEda in-page with a fixture and focused layout and no session persistence; scripted steps double as tests. Screenshots generated by Playwright in the deploy job, including each live example's state as the narrow-screen fallback. Settings and DSL references generated. Two-stage gate: static check in the demo build, browser check in the deploy job before upload. Docs move to /docs/<topic> as a clean break; ?view=docs is removed with no redirect.

success_moves.move: Derive coverage targets from code (registry, coverage.ts) rather than a hand list
success_moves.benefit: New chart types and required features fail the build automatically

success_moves.move: Split gate into a fast static stage (no browser, runs in demo build and locally) and a browser stage (deploy job)
success_moves.benefit: Most drift is caught in seconds locally; browser cost only paid in CI

success_moves.move: Make scripted example steps double as tests
success_moves.benefit: One artifact both demonstrates and proves the claim; drift fails deploy

success_moves.move: Fix the deploy toolchain (Node 24, pnpm 11.9.0, frozen lockfile) before adding build plugins or gates
success_moves.benefit: Gate and MDX failures are attributable

success_moves.move: Mount live examples in-page with no persistence rather than framing /examples/<id>
success_moves.benefit: Readers' saved analyses are never touched; focused layouts; parent DOM is scriptable for step checks

success_moves.move: Use each live example's generated screenshot as its narrow-screen fallback
success_moves.benefit: One declaration yields the interactive and static views; nothing hand-captured

first_proof.question: Can the shipped guides run on MDX behind a two-stage gate, with a live, scripted, screenshot-backed example, without touching reader sessions?
first_proof.artifact: After the toolchain fix, port scatter/bar/rendering to MDX; bar gets a live example with one scripted step, a generated narrow screenshot, a generated settings table; both gate stages run in deploy
first_proof.observation: Fake registration, renamed example, broken step, and deleted image each fail the right stage with a named message; pages read the same at 1280/783/390; saved sessions untouched
first_proof.decision_rule: Scale to catalogue; switch to embed-mode frame if in-page mounts leak; keep static stage blocking if the browser stage is flaky until fixed
